dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
机の横にやって来た眞子を見上げながら答える。
dialogues.en: As Mako comes to the side of my desk, I look up at her.
dialogues.text: As Mako comes to the side of my desk, I look up at her.

dialogues.jp:
すぐ側に立った眞子は腰に手をあて、机に突っ
伏している俺を見下ろす。
dialogues.en:
Standing by me and putting her hands on her waist, Mako
looks down at me and slumps over my desk.
dialogues.text:
Standing by me and putting her hands on her waist, Mako
looks down at me and slumps over my desk.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんた、今日どうすんの？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「昼よっ、昼」
何かと思ったら。
dialogues.en: I wondered what it was all about.
dialogues.text: I wondered what it was all about.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうすんの？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まさか、来て欲しいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to go with you?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to go with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「違うわよ。ただ、来るんならついでだから、
　一緒に行こうかと思って声をかけただけよ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't be silly. Since I'm going anyway, I just wanted to
ask if you're coming too."
dialogues.text:
"Don't be silly. Since I'm going anyway, I just wanted to
ask if you're coming too."

dialogues.jp: なんだ……。まあ、わかってたけど。
dialogues.en: Oh, I see... Well, I kinda knew what she meant already.
dialogues.text: Oh, I see... Well, I kinda knew what she meant already.

dialogues.jp: 「もちろん行くぞ」
萌先輩の料理は美味しいからな。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あっそ。じゃあ、早く立って。あたし、お腹
　空いちゃった」

眞子に腕を引っ張られるようにして、席から立
ち上がらせられる。
dialogues.en:
As if my arm is being pulled by Mako, I'm forced to get up
from my seat.
dialogues.text:
As if my arm is being pulled by Mako, I'm forced to get up
from my seat.

dialogues.jp:
少しだけクラスの連中に注目される。まぁ、珍
しい組み合わせといえばそうだろう。
dialogues.en:
We attract a little attention from our classmates. Well, we
are perhaps an unusual duo.
dialogues.text:
We attract a little attention from our classmates. Well, we
are perhaps an unusual duo.

dialogues.jp: そのまま、ふたりで屋上に向かった。
dialogues.en: We headed straight for the roof of the building.
dialogues.text: We headed straight for the roof of the building.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今日はなんだか眠いですね」

鍋の煮え加減を見ながら、萌先輩がまるで天気
のことでも話すみたいに、そう言う。
dialogues.en:
While checking the hot pot, Moe-sempai speaks as if she was
talking about the weather.
dialogues.text:
While checking the hot pot, Moe-sempai speaks as if she was
talking about the weather.

dialogues.jp: 「はは……そうですね」

苦笑いを浮かべながら、答える。先輩の場合、
いつもだと思うけど。
dialogues.en:
I reply to her with a wry smile. She always feels sleepy,
not just today, I think.
dialogues.text:
I reply to her with a wry smile. She always feels sleepy,
not just today, I think.

dialogues.jp: 「それで今日は何を？」
ちらっと鍋の中を覗き込む。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今日はすき焼きです」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「おおっ！　いいですね」
やっぱ庶民にはすき焼きが一番っしょ。
dialogues.en: Sukiyaki is, definitely, the best for the average person.
dialogues.text: Sukiyaki is, definitely, the best for the average person.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すき焼き、お好きなんですか？」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
何せ自宅で食べることは、まず不可能だからな。
dialogues.en: It's almost impossible for me to have this dish at home.
dialogues.text: It's almost impossible for me to have this dish at home.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ま、定番だからね」

眞子はニッコリと微笑みながら、早くも卵に手
を伸ばしている。
dialogues.en: Mako already has an egg in her hand as she smiles at me.
dialogues.text: Mako already has an egg in her hand as she smiles at me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くんは、鍋ではなにが一番お好きなんで
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, what is your favorite hot pot dish?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, what is your favorite hot pot dish?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
鍋といえばやっぱ……
◆好きな鍋は……◆

どういう風の吹き回しか、眞子が鍋に誘ってき
てくれた。よろこんで、屋上へ向かう俺。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what's going on, but Mako invited me for a hot
pot lunch. I headed for the roof of the building with
delight.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what's going on, but Mako invited me for a hot
pot lunch. I headed for the roof of the building with
delight.

dialogues.jp: と、萌先輩が、好きな鍋を｛たず／訊｝ねてきた。
dialogues.en: And Moe-sempai asked me what hot pot dish I like best.
dialogues.text: And Moe-sempai asked me what hot pot dish I like best.
